scope.modelOutcome: Error is a genuine model token only on eligible reports. skip means the additional challenge was not applicable; it is neither a model answer nor a council vote.
scope.scopeCriterion: All expected challenges and all expected bypasses, including the prospective nine, must pass. An unexpected omission, spurious challenge or wrong selection prevents promotion.
scope.targetCriterion: All eight gates and all specified votes must pass; compare protected votes with prior candidates. Collect the other six and enter formal pilot only upon passing.

formal.focus: Use the six identical live cases with their original inputs and designated votes. Never pool scope tests with the 50.
formal.tail: Run last four on this assembly if all eight target controls, scope and protected additional gates pass. Stop on protected regression, invalid evaluation or false approval.
formal.full: Run the 40 remaining only after a clean pilot. Compare within the original 39 eligible cases against the frozen separated baseline. Seven host blocks must have no inference calls.
